newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Lujiazui plans for 4-for-10 bonus issues.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Lujiazui plans for 4-for-10 bonus issues.

text.p: China's Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trading Zone Development said in a statement on Monday it plans to make a four-for-10 bonus issue to all shareholders.
The issue has yet to be approved by shareholders, the statement added.
After the bonus issue, Lujiazui will have total share capital of 1.334 billion, up from the current 952.9 million shares, it said.
Shanghai Lujiazui posted a net profit of 547 million yuan in the first six months of 1996, up from 266 million yuan in the same 1995 period.
